summary: CoinShares PLC filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing the immediate appointment of Matt Morris as Chief Financial Officer. Morris succeeds Richard Nash, CFO since 2019, who remains with the Company as a senior member of the CEO Office. The company framed the move as a planned succession tied to its Nasdaq listing, U.S. GAAP transition and U.S. public-company reporting build-out; Morris served as Deputy CFO since August 2026. No compensation, board recommendation, advisor, price or regulatory clock was disclosed. Watch for any 20-F disclosure on severance and control environment continuity.
